mapper.sql: SELECT a.*, c.analysis_id cache_record_id, c.cache_source_id FROM ai_analysis a LEFT JOIN analysis_cache_record c ON c.analysis_id=a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_analysis (event_id, requested_by, status, model, summary, attack_chain, recommendations, confidence, false_positive_notes, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost_ms) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{actor}, #{status}, #{model}, #{summary}, #{chain}, #{recommendations}, #{confidence}, #{falsePositiveHint}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{costMs})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_evidence ee JOIN rule_hit rh ON rh.id=ee.rule_hit_id WHERE ee.event_id=#{eventId} AND rh.log_entry_id=#{logId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_analysis_evidence (analysis_id, log_entry_id, citation_order, stage_no) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{logId}, #{order}, #{stage})
INSERT INTO analysis_cache_record (analysis_id, fingerprint, cache_source_id, saved_tokens) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{fingerprint}, #{sourceId}, #{savedTokens})
mapper.select: WHERE a.event_id=#{eventId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_analysis WHERE event_id=#{eventId}
WHERE a.event_id=#{eventId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
